# Motion365 Workspace Notes

- Keep video compositions deterministic and frame-driven with Remotion hooks.
- Register CLI-renderable compositions in `src/remotion.tsx` and keep the browser player pointed at the same component.
- Keep composition input props typed and document any new render props in `README.md`.
- Use `npm run build` and `npm run lint` to validate changes; use `npm run render` to produce the sample MP4.
